decisions.inventory: 674 explicit cards across eleven collector families: Base 250, Emerald 250, five numbered inserts totaling 60, Metal-issued Autographics 47 and Purple Foil 47, Base Shredders 18, physical Checklists 2. No checklist generated by extrapolating a parallel from base.
decisions.autographicsScope: Metal product page old summary says 54 regular autos. Current TCDB shared-program per-card distribution captions and independent 132-row brand matrix agree on 47 MT subjects for both regular and Purple Foil. Exclude all non-Metal and replacement-only asterisk subjects. Index legacy aliases 266579/273437 redirect to canonical global namespaces 12241/12242, which are captured in full before product filtering.
decisions.rookies: Four true base RCs: 223 Danys Baez, 228 Jeff DaVanon, 245 Juan Sosa, 248 Trace Coquillette. Prospects is not synonymous with RC. BCP erroneously calls 249 Rob Ramsay RC; his earlier 1999 Fleer Tradition Update U92 true RC is independently evidenced. No RC suffix on Emerald/inserts/autographs.
decisions.namesTeams: All 250 base identities and teams cross-checked to supplementary checklist. Every Emerald identity/subset/team compared to base after scan-grounded correction of Emerald 88 Kenny Rogers from Mets to Rangers. Base 76 Griffey identifies Reds despite Mariners uniform; Fusion 1F, Heavy Metal 3HM and Hit Machines 1H correctly retain Mariners. Regular Gabe Kapler Autographics back confirms Tigers; do not copy base teams into shared-program autographs.
decisions.pendingTeamVerification: Purple Foil Roger Cedeno source Houston Astros vs regular New York Mets; Purple Foil Gabe Kapler source Texas Rangers vs regular Detroit Tigers. No rare-variant scans found; keep each catalogue value provisionally and explicitly flag both. Team fields populated, but these two affiliations are not claimed verified. Release remains blocked.
decisions.numbering: Keep printed insert numbers with suffixes (e.g. 1 F, 1 HM, 1 H, 1 PP, 1 TS). Unnumbered autograph/memorabilia IDs NNO-NAME-SLUG and generic NNO-A/B are stable VCS keys, not printed identifiers. Names are clean, metadata in subset/variant.
decisions.pack: Hobby 10 cards per pack, 28 packs per box verified by original package photographs and BCP. Retail 9 cards/20 packs differs. Prospects remain in full base/parallel families; VCS uniform card selection flattens historical subset scarcity.
decisions.odds: Known Hobby denominators: Fusion 4, Talent Show 4, Platinum Portraits 8, Heavy Metal 20, Hit Machines 20, Autographics 96, Base Shredders 288. Emerald short set 1:4 plus Prospects 1:8 implies 3/8 expected hits, integer denominator unsupported: null pending QA, not rounded. Purple and checklists unknown: null. No odds copied from the 1:72 Skybox brand or inferred from /50. Rates live only on ProductSets, not card variants.
decisions.exclusions: Exclude unsigned Alex Rodriguez #100 dealer/media Promotional Sample. A forum and sales listings describe a signed /750 sample, but no pack-issued origin verified; not added to pack checklist. No invented hologram, jersey or bat family; Base Shredders contains game-used bases. No unrelated 1999 Metal Universe or 2000 basketball cards.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing and image harvesting. Release blocked pending two Purple team scans, Emerald odds representation, unknown odds, pack QA, prices and images. No production database access or deployment.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Full 250-card checklist; #201–250 Prospects historically short-printed. One collector family with uniform availability under current VCS convention.

productSets.name: Emerald
productSets.notes: Full 250-card green foil parallel, independently sourced. #1–200 historically 1:4, #201–250 1:8; aggregate expected hits 3/8 per pack, denominator 8/3 cannot be stored as an integer. Odds null pending pack-model decision; do not round or split checklist.

productSets.name: Autographics
productSets.notes: 47 Metal-issued subjects, cross-checked current shared-program annotations against independent MT brand matrix; not the entire 132-card shared program. Hobby 1:96. Unnumbered name-based VCS IDs.

productSets.name: Autographics Purple Foil
productSets.notes: Same 47 Metal subjects; purple foil /50. Odds unverified. Two catalogued team affiliations (Cedeno, Kapler) pending rare-variant scan verification. Unnumbered name-based VCS IDs.

productSets.name: Base Shredders
productSets.notes: 18 unnumbered cards with game-used base pieces, not bats or jerseys; name-based VCS IDs. Hobby 1:288.

productSets.name: Checklists
productSets.notes: Two physical unnumbered cards: 1–192 and 193–250 plus inserts; both front/back scans reviewed. Local IDs NNO-A/B are not printed numbers. Generic checklist teams intentionally blank; exact insertion odds unknown.
